{{Top|leg}}
The '''Guild Assignments Group''' was a division of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] guild on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It was responsible for managing all assignments of Rodian hunters leaving the planet for the first [[Time/Legends|time]]. Dispatchers typically matched hunters with offworld employers.
